Lemma
[The limit of bounded-width surfaces cannot be Euclidean] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0072, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0073 1. ch28:28.40\group Finite Width

If pointed complete surfaces converge smoothly and have uniformly bounded width, their limit is not the Euclidean plane.
